name: Red Wings Widget
description: Detroit Red Wings NHL schedule widget + companion app: next-game countdown, last result, and division standings.
changelog: Pixel-perfect Frosted Ice & Home Red Sweater overhaul matching Concept 2 mockup exactly.
Replaced serif/typewriter fonts with clean, athletic sans-serif grotesque typography throughout.
Redesigned standings into dual-column horizontal seed pill rows: Playoff Seeds (1-4) with glowing Detroit red pill, and In The Hunt (5-8).
Restyled matchup hero with side-by-side crests, tags, bold records, and prominent red countdown timer.
Fixed white @ symbol rendering inside crimson puck clash badge.
Set Frosted Ice Home Red as default theme on installation.
